subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: What should Anthropic QuickStart do before first terminal hatch when the selected default is Opus and billing or credits may fail?
rationale: The source-backed gap is clear, but changing provider defaults, adding a billing preflight, or requiring an explicit paid-model confirmation is a user-visible provider/setup policy choice.

options.title: Warn and confirm before hatch
options.body: Keep the current Anthropic default but show an explicit paid-credit warning and recovery path before sending the first terminal chat.

options.title: Change the fresh-install default
options.body: Select a lower-risk Anthropic first-run model by default while preserving existing stored user choices and documenting the upgrade behavior.

options.title: Document intentional behavior only
options.body: Leave QuickStart behavior unchanged and rely on docs and post-failure billing copy, accepting that the first useful run can still appear broken.

recommendation.title: Warn and confirm before hatch
recommendation.body: Keep the current Anthropic default but show an explicit paid-credit warning and recovery path before sending the first terminal chat.

likelyOwner.reason: The Anthropic provider default and setup wizard behavior most closely trace to this person's prior work on the affected setup/default surfaces.
